# Omarchy UI

Source: https://github.com/huacnlee/omarchy-ui
Commit: 8def54298bda03b8d481436e62b5885af4eed674
License: MIT (see LICENSE)

The public JavaScript modules and type declarations are vendored unchanged.
The application imports src/index.js by relative path so first launch works
offline, without Git or a pre-populated Shell dependency cache.
